name: i-hate-editing
title_zh: 丢进素材文件夹，还你一条带字幕配乐调色的成片
tagline_zh: 口播录完不想碰剪辑台？它替你切好、上字幕、配乐、调色，连封面文案和竖版横版都出好。你说人话，它做手艺。
tagline_en: Hate editing talking heads? It cuts, captions, scores, grades, and exports vertical + horizontal with caption &.
desc_en: Turn raw talking-head takes into a finished, publishable video package — cut, captioned, scored, graded, with platform variants, post caption and thumbnail. For short-form vertical and YouTube talking-head footage. Opinionated by design; the studio makes the craft decisions and takes plain-language direction. Use when someone drops recorded footage in a folder and wants it edited.
why_zh: 不是参数面板，是拿主意的剪辑师。它先按叙事逻辑定剪，再套风格，你只改方向不抠帧。
why_en: Not a timeline of knobs—a cutter with taste. It decides the edit from narrative logic, then takes plain-language notes, not.
limit_zh: 只认横屏或竖屏的说话人头（talking-head）素材；不处理多机位、无人物B-roll混剪、或需要绿幕合成的镜头。
limit_en: Only single-angle talking-head footage (horizontal or vertical). No multicam, no pure B-roll montage, no chroma key. Output ends at final video +.
title_en: Drop footage, get a finished cut with captions, music, grade
